definitionZh: 随机选择并显示一个或多个已开槽的子项，隐藏其余的。使用它来旋转推荐、显示特色内容、显示每日提示或为静态页面添加多样性。
sourceDefinition: Randomly picks and displays one or more of its slotted children, hiding the rest. Use it to rotate testimonials, surface featured content, show a tip of the day, or add variety to an otherwise static page.
